lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots organized in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The column immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit displays five primary nodes, followed by subsequent columns forming a regular spatial grid along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where the spots serve as primary intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-colored top edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of remoras (Echeneidae) is visible attached to and swimming near the pectoral and ventral regions. A human hand is also visible in the right-middle field of view.
